# `json2vec`

> `json2vec` is a Python package for building PyTorch/Lightning models from JSON-like schemas. It models tabular fields, nested arrays, typed data, self-supervised reconstruction, supervised targets, embeddings, preprocessing, prediction writing, and serving.

## Start Here

- [AI Quickstart](https://json2vec.github.io/json2vec/ai-quickstart/): shortest reliable API map for agents and generated examples.
- [Getting Started](https://json2vec.github.io/json2vec/getting-started/): first-run train/predict workflow with tabular and nested examples.
- [API Reference](https://json2vec.github.io/json2vec/reference/api/): public package exports.
- [Agent Guide](https://github.com/json2vec/json2vec/blob/main/AGENTS.md): repo-local instructions for AI coding agents.

## Core Concepts

- [Why `json2vec`](https://json2vec.github.io/json2vec/motivation/): motivation and modeling philosophy.
- [Model Tree](https://json2vec.github.io/json2vec/core-concepts/model-tree/): schema nodes, addresses, and forward-pass structure.
- [Query Paths](https://json2vec.github.io/json2vec/core-concepts/querypaths/): default and custom JMESPath query paths.
- [Built-In Data Types](https://json2vec.github.io/json2vec/core-concepts/data-types/): type selection guide.
- [Learning Modes & Embeddings](https://json2vec.github.io/json2vec/core-concepts/embeddings/): supervised targets, masked reconstruction, unsupervised representation learning, and embedding export workflows.
- [Mutations](https://json2vec.github.io/json2vec/core-concepts/mutations/): schema mutation and transfer-learning workflow.
- [Whitepaper](https://github.com/json2vec/json2vec/blob/main/docs/whitepaper.typ): full conceptual background.

## Data Types

- [Array](https://json2vec.github.io/json2vec/data-types/array/): repeated nested contexts.
- [Number](https://json2vec.github.io/json2vec/data-types/number/): continuous scalar values.
- [Category](https://json2vec.github.io/json2vec/data-types/category/): categorical scalar values.
- [Set](https://json2vec.github.io/json2vec/data-types/set/): unordered label sets.
- [DateParts](https://json2vec.github.io/json2vec/data-types/dateparts/): timestamp/calendar features.
- [Entity](https://json2vec.github.io/json2vec/data-types/entity/): local repeated identity matching.
- [Vector](https://json2vec.github.io/json2vec/data-types/vector/): precomputed dense vectors.
- [Text](https://json2vec.github.io/json2vec/data-types/text/): free-form text embeddings.
- [Custom Data Types](https://json2vec.github.io/json2vec/data-types/tensorfields/): extension guide.

## Tutorials And Guides

- [Hello World](https://json2vec.github.io/json2vec/tutorials/hello-world/): tiny supervised workflow.
- [Masked Pretraining](https://json2vec.github.io/json2vec/tutorials/pretraining/): self-supervised reconstruction.
- [Nested Supervised Training](https://json2vec.github.io/json2vec/tutorials/nested-supervised-training/): repeated child objects.
- [Supervised Tabular Training](https://json2vec.github.io/json2vec/tutorials/supervised-tabular-training/): tabular comparison point.
- [Serving](https://json2vec.github.io/json2vec/tutorials/serving/): deployment wrapper workflow.
- [Training With Lightning](https://json2vec.github.io/json2vec/guides/lightning/): how `j2v.Model`, data modules, and Lightning `Trainer` fit together.
- [Data Modules](https://json2vec.github.io/json2vec/guides/data-modules/): choose `PolarsDataModule` or `StreamingDataModule` and configure splits.
- [Batch Inference](https://json2vec.github.io/json2vec/guides/batch-inference/): write large prediction jobs with `Trainer.predict(...)` and `j2v.Writer`.
- [Preprocessors](https://json2vec.github.io/json2vec/guides/preprocessors/): Python transformations before tensorization.
- [Postprocessors](https://json2vec.github.io/json2vec/guides/postprocessors/): prediction output shaping for APIs, writers, and serving.
- [Field Stacking](https://json2vec.github.io/json2vec/guides/field-stacking/): query pattern for shared repeated semantic roles.
- [Field Importance](https://json2vec.github.io/json2vec/guides/field-importance/): pruning and field-level diagnostics.

## Case Studies

- [Device Tenure](https://json2vec.github.io/json2vec/case-studies/device-tenure/): account-risk example replacing a handcrafted tenure scalar with nested event histories.

## Agent Notes

- Use `import json2vec as j2v`.
- Use `j2v.Model.from_schema(...)`; do not invent `Struct(...)`.
- Use `name=...` to name the generated root context; it is always length `1`.
- Use `target=True` for supervised targets; it is exact shorthand for `p_prune=1.0`.
- Use `embed=True` for emitted embeddings, and `p_mask` for stochastic self-supervised reconstruction with rates lower than `1.0`.
- Use `Array(..., name=..., max_length=...)` for repeated contexts; add `overflow="tail"` for newest-last histories or `overflow="error"` for strict schemas.
- Use Lightning `Trainer` with `PolarsDataModule` or `StreamingDataModule` for training and batch prediction.
- Use `j2v.Writer` for Parquet batch inference output.
- Use preprocessors for Python input shaping and postprocessors for prediction output shaping.
